values: Executed 19 October 2026. Automated backend tests using mocked Google services.
Precondition: fresh seeded workspace and an active role account for every test. Fixture working date: 14 October 2026.
Scope: live Sheets writes, browser interactions and device permission prompts were not tested. Full regression: 235 passed.
Source: recorded JUnit role results and the approved four-role test-case report.
Log in with the seeded active account and valid password.
Session issued; returned user has the correct role; stored token is hashed.
Log in with an incorrect password.
Correct identity; credentials, sessions and audit tables are absent.
Punch in with required coordinates, reject duplicate, then punch out.
One completed personal attendance record, two saved location events; duplicate changes nothing.
Create a work log while supplying another employee ID.
Saved work log belongs to the authenticated user.
Log out, then reuse the same session to load the workspace.
Logout succeeds; reused session returns UNAUTHENTICATED.
Load workspace containing two projects and tasks for different employees.
Only own employee profile, assigned task and associated project are returned.
Complete own task, then try to change an unrelated task.
Own task saved and audited; unrelated task remains unchanged.
Try to promote another employee and create an Admin account.
Both operations rejected without changing stored records.
Submit personal leave with forged owner and Approved status, then try reviewing existing leave.
Leave saved as own Pending request; review rejected.
